name: Data product
short_description: A bundle of related data assets, such as tables, files and Power BI reports, packaged for a defined use case with owners and a business description, so others can discover and request access to it.

evidence.quote: You can search the catalog by keyword, by business area, by data product,
Nobody owns a single data product
A data product is a business concept with a name, a description, owners and a list of data assets
